FIXTURE NOTE (provenance-survival, case P5a — THE LOAD-BEARING CASE).

This is the v4.37 producer surface, reproduced in shape: a thin "output of
record" stub left when the plan was hub-authored directly rather than
transcribed from a spoke comment. It carries NONE of Survival-Set rows 1-5.

Paired with prov-label-absent.md it is the demonstration that a delta-only
mechanism is vacuous. Comment 0, plan 0, set-difference empty — PROV-DELTA
PASSES, honestly and correctly, because nothing was lost between the surfaces.
Nothing was lost because nothing was ever there.

A check built only on that comparison reports CLEAN on the exact release that
failed. PROV-PRESENCE reads the plan alone and FAILs here, which is why the
absolute limb is not optional decoration on top of the delta.
